full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph looks sharply upward at a man standing beneath a broad glass-and-steel canopy. He fills the lower and central frame from the waist up. A dark flat cap shades his eyes, while a heavy coat with broad lapels folds across his chest over a collared shirt or scarf. His hands appear tucked into the coat pockets, and his head turns slightly toward the left with a serious, watchful expression. The low viewpoint enlarges his torso and makes him loom against the geometric roof. Above and behind him, a network of dark metal beams, fine crossbars, and translucent roof panels cuts diagonally across the pale sky. Some panels are streaked or mottled, and the beams intersect in sharp triangles and elongated grids. The roof structure sweeps from the upper left toward the upper right, establishing a vigorous counterpoint to the man's heavy, almost static outline. Light enters through the canopy, producing bright gray panes and deep black linework. The man's face is partly shadowed beneath the cap, but the ridge of his nose and the curve of his cheek catch pale light. The coat retains coarse wool-like texture within its broad charcoal folds. Fine grain and strong tonal contrast give the picture the tactile finish of an older photographic print. There is no readable sign or decorative text. The composition compresses a single human form and industrial geometry into an imposing view, with the foreground figure grounded by a dark coat and the roof opening into a lattice of light. It feels purposeful and austere, expressing modern urban energy through perspective rather than action.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白摄影以陡峭仰角望向站在宽大玻璃钢架顶棚下的男子。他从腰部以上填满画面下方与中部。深色扁帽遮住眼睛，厚外套的宽驳领在胸前交叠，里面露出有领上衣或围巾。双手似乎插在外套口袋，头略朝左转，表情严肃而警觉。低机位放大他的躯干，使他立在几何屋顶前显得高大。身后与上方的深色金属梁、细横杆和半透明屋面板斜切过浅色天空。有些板面带条痕或斑驳，梁架交汇成锐利三角和拉长网格。屋顶结构从左上扫向右上，与男子厚重且几乎静止的轮廓形成有力对位。光穿过顶棚，产生明亮灰色板面与深黑线条。帽檐下男子面孔部分隐在阴影里，但鼻梁与脸颊弧线承接浅色光。外套的宽阔炭灰褶面仍保有粗羊毛般肌理。细颗粒和强明暗反差赋予画面老照片印刷品的可触完成度。没有可读标牌或装饰文字。构图把一道人形与工业几何压缩为气势逼人的视角，前景人物由深外套稳住，屋顶则向明亮线架敞开。气质坚定而冷峻，以透视而非动作表达现代城市能量。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast monochrome photography uses an emphatic low camera angle to set a dark, weighty silhouette against a bright lattice of structural lines. Diagonal beams, fine crossbars, and translucent planes create rapid geometric intersections above broad, comparatively still foreground forms. Pale backlight from a roof or sky carves the outline while leaving faces and fabric partly in shadow. Textures remain material: coarse cloth, streaked glass, and dark metal all read differently within a narrow scale of blacks and grays. Fine film grain and the slightly dry finish of a printed photograph support an austere documentary tone. The composition feels forceful because perspective enlarges the near subject and lets architectural vectors converge overhead. Keep the image uncluttered by text or decorative effects; spatial tension and light-dark structure carry the style.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差黑白摄影用鲜明低机位把深色厚重剪影置于明亮的结构线格前。斜梁、细横杆和半透明平面在宽阔而相对静止的前景形体上方形成快速几何交叉。屋顶或天空的浅色逆光刻出轮廓，同时让面孔与衣料部分留在阴影中。肌理保持材料差别：粗布、带条痕的玻璃与深色金属即使在有限黑灰范围内仍各有质感。细胶片颗粒和略干的相纸完成度支持冷峻纪实语气。构图之所以有力，在于透视放大近处主体，让建筑向量在头顶聚合。不以文字或装饰效果填满画面；空间张力与明暗结构足以承载风格。

theme_zh: 一名戴帽男子站在棱角分明的玻璃钢架屋顶下
name: Alexander Rodchenko
